questions.solution:

25 ÷ 5 × 2 + 25 - 11 = 24

**Calculation:**

By option Method:

⇒ 25 ÷ 5 × 2 + 25 - 24 = 11

⇒ 5 × 2 + 25 - 24

⇒ 10 + 1

⇒ 11 = 11

⇒ 25 ÷ 2 × 5 + 25 - 11 = 24

⇒ 12.5 x 5 + 25 -11 = 24

⇒ 76.5 ≠ 24

This is not correct the equation.

**Option III: **After interchanging **5, 25**

⇒ 25 ÷ 25 × 2 + 5 - 11 = 24

⇒ 1 × 2 + 5 - 11 = 24

Rightarrow (1)/(f) = (1)/(v) + (1)/(u)

so f = (u v)/(u+v)

options.text: Male germ cell - small with food store, Female - large and motile
Male germ cell - small and motile, Female - large with food store

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** __Male germ cell - small and motile, Female - large with food store__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key-points __**

Here's a table that explains the characteristics of male germ cells (sperm cells) and female germ cells (oocytes):

 
 

 Characteristic

• Explanation:
 
• **Size:**
 
 
• Male germ cells, or sperm cells, are **generally small in size**.
 
• They are specialized for mobility and reaching the **egg for fertilization**.
 
• In contrast, female germ cells, known as oocytes or eggs, are comparatively larger due to the presence of abundant cytoplasm to support the **developing embryo**.
 
 
 
• **Motility:**
 
 
• Sperm cells are highly motile, equipped with a whip-like tail called a** flagellum**, which propels them toward the egg.
 
• Their motility allows them to swim through the female reproductive tract to reach the site of **fertilization**.
 
• On the other hand, oocytes are non-motile and remain stationary within the ovaries until they are **released during ovulation**.
 
 
 
• **Food Store: **
 
 
• Male germ cells (**sperm cells**) have a limited food store.
 
• They primarily carry genetic material necessary for fertilization but rely on the female reproductive tract for **nourishment**.
 
• In contrast, female germ cells (**oocytes**) possess a substantial food store in the form of yolk or nutrient-rich cytoplasm.
 
• This food supply is crucial for supporting the early stages of embryo development until it can establish its own** nutrient supply**.

• These nutrients are utilized for growth, maintenance, and various metabolic processes in these plant parts.

questions.question: Red colour is scattered the ____ by fog or smoke because its wavelength is ____ than the wavelength of other colour components of white light.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** __'least, more'__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When light passes through a medium like **fog or smoke**, it interacts with **particles present in the medium**.
 
• This interaction can cause **scattering of the light.**
 
• The extent of scattering depends on** the wavelength of the light.**
 
• In general, shorter** wavelengths (such as blue and violet) are scattered more easily than longer wavelengths (such as red and orange).**
 
• This phenomenon is known as **Rayleigh scattering.**
 
• The scattering of shorter wavelengths is responsible for the blue color of the **sky during the day.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In the case of fog or smoke, which consist of tiny particles.
 
• The** shorter wavelengths (blue and violet) **are scattered more efficiently.
 
• While the** longer wavelengths (red and orange)** are scattered less.
 
• As a result, the **red color appears less scattered and can penetrate through fog or smoke more effectively than other colors.**
